packageRules.description: An upstream image bump is a fix, so release-please releases it, and the images lock records the new upstream version (JorisJonkers-dev/workspace#140).
linuxserver tags prowlarr x.y.z.build-lsN: the first four are prowlarr's, the last linuxserver's rebuild.
A prowlarr minor or patch release, a linuxserver rebuild, or a newer flaresolverr merges once Pipeline Complete passes; a new prowlarr version is released, and the rest ship with the next one.
A major release waits for approval on the Dependency Dashboard.
A digest moved under the same tag is no new version, so it cannot be released.
